newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post front page - Oct 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post front page - Oct 14.

text.p: The Washington Post carries the following stories on its front page on Oct 14:
CAIRO - Kurdish forces said to be receiving help from Iran recaptured a major city from a rival group supported by Iraqi President Saddam Hussein.
BALTIMORE - The New York Yankees won the American League championship baseball series, ending hopes for local fans of the Baltimore Orioles.
WASHINGTON - Economic disparities are widening between the people benefiting from U.S. prosperity, and those who have not been so lucky.

ATLANTA - Georgia's first black woman representative in Congress, Rep. Cynthia McKinney, is running for reelection in a dramatically redrawn congressional district, and Democrats are worried they may lose her seat to the Republican candidate in the Nov. 5 election.
WASHINGTON - By acting like a commander in chief, President Clinton has helped to erase the image of drift and indecision that dogged him for much of his first three years in office.
WASHINGTON - State and local officials are encouraging the rural poor to relocate to urban areas where work is more plentiful.
